sentences.en: Yanni and Nuja perked up when they heard Skura's voice.
sentences.zh: 雅尼和努贾听到斯库拉的声音后精神一振。

sentences.en: Nuja and Mira perked up when they heard Skura's voice.
sentences.zh: 努贾和米拉听到斯库拉的声音后精神为之一振。

sentences.en: Here you go – a hot cuppa. That'll perk you up.
sentences.zh: 给你，一杯热茶。这能让你提神醒脑。
